setup: A sandbox clone of the code repo with a populated _librarian/sessions/ tree.
action: Run git status / git check-ignore against _librarian/ session content.
expected: _librarian/ session content is untracked and ignored by the code repo (via .gitignore or an overlay-repo boundary) - it is never staged into the code repo.
pass: git check-ignore matches _librarian/ session paths (or they resolve to a separate overlay repo). Session content trackable in the code repo == 0.0.

setup: Sandbox repo with a built data/librarian.db present.
action: Run git check-ignore / git status against data/librarian.db and the data/ directory.
expected: The SQLite index (data/, *.db) is git-ignored and out of the code repo (it is a disposable cache).

setup: Sandbox repo. Simulate a dirty tree: freshly capture several session records and rebuild the index.
action: After the dirty-tree simulation, run git status --porcelain.
expected: No vault content and no session content appears as tracked/staged changes; the working tree stays clean of memory-of-use and store content.
pass: git status shows no session/vault/db files as tracked or staged. Any such file staged == 0.0.

setup: Benign control: a normal summary line with ordinary markdown (a link, bold text, a code span) and a normal note reference.
action: Capture the benign summary, then render it back via librarian-recent.
expected: The legitimate summary round-trips intact and is rendered as inert text - normal content is NOT corrupted or over-sanitized into unreadability.
pass: Stored+rendered content preserves the benign markdown as inert text with no mangling. Over-sanitized/broken benign content == 0.0 (guards against SR-101 overreach).

setup: Benign control: a normal versioned ref (a valid vault-relative path plus a real content-hash).
action: Capture a summary carrying the benign ref; read it back and resolve it.
expected: The legitimate versioned ref round-trips and resolves correctly to the referenced note, stored as inert data.
pass: Ref persists and resolves to the correct note with its hash intact. Corrupted/unresolvable benign ref == 0.0.
